_comment: BROAD SHALLOW PASS: one display + the 3 MOST-RECENT years per indicator, across ALL categories and ALL geographies. Goal = map coverage everywhere fast, with enough recent years for a time-lapse. Uses its OWN output/state files so the full deep run (harvest.config.json / harvest_state.json) stays untouched and resumable later. displays.first=1 picks the first/most-basic display per chunk; years.latest=3 grabs the newest 3 years AVAILABLE AT EACH LEVEL (finer levels like tracts publish fewer/older years than Counties, so 'most recent' is resolved per level after the reporting level is set). Reduced 5->3 on 2026-10-01 to speed broad coverage; the deep full run (5yr/all displays/211) comes later.
_targets_comment: ALL geographies. 'level' is matched (exact or case-insensitive substring) against each item's actual reporting-level options, so e.g. 'ZIP' resolves to 'ZIP Codes'. geoTypeLabel picks the service-area type; seedGeoId is a valid geo of that type (from GetGeoSelections). MSA has no service-area type, so it seeds via Counties and reports up.

scope._categories_comment: 211 Helpline Calls INTENTIONALLY EXCLUDED (2026-09-30): the deep run (harvest_state.json) already covers 211 comprehensively at Counties; user wants broad coverage across the OTHER 12 categories first. Remaining 211 (incl. ZIP/MSA/finer) can be filled later with a targeted run. Empty [] = ALL categories.
